text.tspan: Maria, the hand of the Lord is steadier than the
pressure leaning against you. His power is not
diminished by the size of what you are facing.
Look to Christ, who endured the cross and now
strengthens weary hearts to keep walking. Take
heart; God is able to keep you standing.
"Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face
